children: Vistagen Therapeutics began using a new corporate presentation summarizing clinical progress and a proposed Phase 3 LSAS trial for fasedienol.
Filed Exhibit 99.1: new corporate presentation detailing pipeline and regulatory strategy under Regulation FD.
Fasedienol: PALISADE-2 met SUDS primary endpoint (p=0.015); proposal for a U.S. Phase 3 LSAS trial (N=350, 6 weeks).
Open-label extensions showed progressive LSAS improvements over months with repeated as-needed use.
Safety: favorable tolerability across studies and LTSS (N=481); common TEAEs included headache (17%) and COVID-19 (11.4%).
Pipeline: itruvone and refisolone reported positive Phase 2a signals for MDD and menopausal hot flashes, respectively; additional Phase 2 candidates include PH15 and PH284.
